description: This file is a React component that handles OAuth callback redirects in a Next.js application. It reads URL query parameters, determines the OAuth provider, and redirects the user accordingly, encapsulating routing logic and UI fallback.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackRouter
methods.description: Main component that renders a Suspense fallback and wraps the inner OAuth callback handling logic.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackRouterInner
methods.description: Handles extraction of query parameters and performs redirects based on OAuth provider and status.
